greeting: Oh. Hello. Didn't hear you over the sound of... existential dread.
Sooty, they call me. Because of the soot. Obviously.
Another day, another layer of fine particulate matter.
You're back. The world keeps turning. The soot keeps falling.
Welcome to the slag pits. Beautiful, in a ruined kind of way.
I collect soot. It's... not as glamorous as it sounds.
The blackness covers everything. Eventually. Even hope. ...Too dark? Sorry.
At least my barrel matches my mood. And my face. Everything's black here.
dialog.soot_craft: I make ART from soot. Drawings, mostly. They smudge. Impermanent. Like life. ...I made a nice portrait of a lizard yesterday.
dialog.artistic_inspiration: The volcano's destruction creates BEAUTY, if you look closely. Charred trees have interesting shapes. The lava makes patterns. ...I'm not weird, you're weird.
dialog.scorch_comparison: Scorch finds SHINY things. I find the DARK things. Together we make... a complete set, I guess. He's too cheerful.
dialog.melancholy_philosophy: Fire takes everything eventually. But before it does, there's warmth. That's... nice, right?
rumor: They say there's a fire that never goes out. Deep in the magma chambers. Beautiful. Terrifying.
Tide's water puts out fire. Can you imagine? A whole zone of... dampness?
Mire's fog covers everything too. Different particles. Same obscuring.
Frost's snow is supposedly CLEAN. White. Pure. Sounds fake.
dialog.soot_collection_tips: The best soot comes from controlled burns. Wildfire soot is too... angry. You can taste it.
farewell: Don't let the fire consume you. ...Unless you want it to. No judgment.
Return if you need... darkness. Or art supplies.
May your days be warm, but not TOO warm.
The soot claims us all. Eventually. Bye for now.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn soot is... fresh. Optimistic, almost.
dialog.time_noon: Too bright. Too hot. The soot becomes angry.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is perfect. Everything's orange and black. Beautiful.
dialog.time_night: Night soot is mysterious. Full of secrets.

party_reactions.kade: You're... very philosophical. For a barrel-dweller.
party_reactions.nix7: Existential philosophy detected. Unusual for this species.
party_reactions.twist: You seem SAD! Want a HUG?! Hugs fix sadness!
party_reactions.korr: Darkness can be beautiful. You see what others miss.
party_reactions.renna: Your soot drawings sound fascinating. May I see one?
party_reactions.suresh: Even in ash, you find art. There is hope in that.
party_reactions.sova: Cheer up. Or don't. Your choice.
party_reactions.grit: Seen soldiers like this. Seen too much. But they survive.
party_reactions.ashka: You understand fire's beauty AND its cost. Rare.
party_reactions.callum: I... have a clean cloth? For your face?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're the one who keeps visiting. Why? Not complaining. Just curious.
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend. Would you like to see my latest soot sketch?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You actually appreciate my art. Here - my best piece. It's of you. Made from volcanic ash. Don't smudge it.
